verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own questionnaire automation. It generates responses for new questionnaires and runs workflows 'from start to finish' ending in submit, which implies it takes questionnaires in and returns them. No evidence names any format, and import or export in the customer's original format is never documented. missing for 10: explicit support for SIG and CAIQ formats, portal integrations, spreadsheet import/export, export in the original customer format, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent

citations.quote: Vanta combs through your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires.
Streamline security reviews with agentic workflows that automate questionnaires from start to finish. Vanta takes care of the heavy lifting—so all you need to do is review, approve, and submit.
Four new endpoints manage the responses on a Customer Trust questionnaire.
